name: supply-sophie-unanswered-round
narrative: Sophie runs RUTF procurement for the Connect-RUTF program. 17 days ago she asked six suppliers to quote tender 2: half have never answered, despite two reminders, and the deadline is four days off, so chasing them is still worth it; and she forwards whatever does arrive to an AI that records it. Sophie opens tender 2 and reads where it stands: collecting quotes with its deadline in 4 days, three of six answered and three silent, each quote recorded from the supplier's own email with the fact it left out, each silent supplier with when she last chased it and a reminder already drafted, and that the tender has not settled how import duty is handled. She opens the reminder drafted for Sahel, which says when Sahel was asked and last reminded, sends it, and marks it sent from the draft itself; no further reminder falls before the deadline. Sahel answers with a quote; Sophie forwards it, and in the tender's history, turned to replies only, Sahel's email comes first: she opens it beside what the AI recorded from it, the reply dated the day it came in. On the comparison, side by side, no quote can be compared yet: the tender's import duty terms are not settled, so Harmattan's carriage-paid quote, which leaves the import to us, waits on them; Kanem has not stated its pack, and Sahel's quote is ex works, so its freight is ours with no freight estimate recorded, and in euros with no exchange rate recorded; our clearing estimate sits on the quotes we import. Back on the tender she settles import duty on its terms line: we import, under the program's duty waiver. Northgate's three questions are still on her, and Reply opens an email drafted with the three questions, an answer to write under each. The comparison then costs the quotes we import under the waiver: Harmattan's becomes comparable, one of three, landed at its quoted price plus our clearing estimate, while Kanem's pack, our freight estimate for Sahel and Sahel's exchange rate are still missing. Importing makes the paperwork hers, and tender 1 shows what that means: its order with Harmattan is at customs, held, waiting on us. Its status view shows nothing received yet, the invoice billed above the agreed price and the days it is late, and To do lists the documents owed to the forwarder and the invoice to review; the forwarder's email in the order's history says the trucks are held at the border on our import permit. Back on her overview, tender 2 reads what changed: three of six answered and none comparable when she opened it, four answered and 1 of 3 comparable, Harmattan, now, its next move hers, the reply to Northgate; the order is hers too, and a RUSF tender she asked two days ago waits on its suppliers, with the moves on her counted against those waiting on suppliers.

sophie.intro: Sophie buys RUTF for the Connect-RUTF program; suppliers and the freight forwarder email her, and she forwards what they send to an AI that records it.
sophie.name: Sophie

features.description: The opener says what the viewer will see and why before any screen is demoed.
features.verify: Review: the title card's voiceover names the chase, the record, the comparison and the overview, in that order

scenes.narrative: Half the suppliers Sophie asked to quote her RUTF tender never answered. Watch her chase them, check what the AI recorded, settle what stops the quotes being compared, and end knowing whose move each procurement is.
scenes.title: The tender half the suppliers never answered

features.description: The tender's status view shows its stage bar on Collecting quotes with the deadline still ahead, in days, and the header's primary action is the collecting stage's (Compare quotes), not Decide.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=stage-bar] li[aria-current=step] reads 'Collecting quotes' and 'deadline in 4 days'; [data-testid=compare-quotes] is the filled button

features.description: The Suppliers table gives each supplier's state, what its quote is missing and when it was last chased, and Waiting on suppliers lists each silent supplier in the table's order, with when it was asked and last chased.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel Nutrition Industries' [data-testid=supplier-state] reads 'Silent 17d' and [data-testid=on-suppliers] contains 'Sahel Nutrition Industries' and 'chased'

features.description: The Answered tile counts replies of all asked.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=tile] Answered reads '3 / 6'

features.description: The tender's header carries its terms on one fact line: import duty, reading Not settled until a value is set, beside the deadline and the day it was asked.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=tender-duty-terms] reads 'Not settled'

scenes.narrative: Sophie asked six suppliers to quote tender 2. The deadline is 4 days off, half have answered and three are silent. Each quote is recorded by the AI from the supplier's own email, with what it left out beside it: Kanem's sachets per carton. Sahel's row shows when she last chased it, and a reminder is ready to send. The terms line says import duty is not settled.
scenes.title: Half the tender never answered

features.description: The drafts panel lists a Reminder draft for each of the three silent suppliers.
features.verify: Playwright: #drafts contains 3 drafts labelled 'Reminder', one for Sahel Nutrition Industries

features.description: Each reminder draft says when the supplier was asked and last reminded.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel's draft [data-testid=draft-why] contains 'Asked', 'Last reminded' and '2nd reminder'

features.description: A reminder draft carries a Sent on date, defaulting to today, and a Mark sent button that saves last_reminder_on and returns to the tender's Suppliers table with Sahel's row marked, its Last chased cell reading Reminder sent and the 3rd reminder; the next reminder is never scheduled after the tender's response deadline.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel's draft shows [data-testid=chase-date] and a 'Mark sent' button; after clicking it, tr[data-changed] is Sahel Nutrition Industries' row and contains 'Reminder sent', '3rd reminder' and 'no further reminder · deadline'

scenes.narrative: Sophie opens the drafts at Sahel's reminder: when Sahel was asked, when she last reminded them, and today's date ready beside Mark sent. Once it has gone she marks it sent, and Sahel's row is recorded: third reminder, sent today, the last before the deadline.
scenes.title: She chases Sahel from a drafted reminder

features.description: Between scenes 2 and 3 the AI records Sahel's emailed quote and reply over the labs MCP with source ref, excerpt and sender.
features.verify: Django shell: the program's newest OperationCall rows are quote_record and outreach_update on channel 'mcp' with source_sender 'Amadou Issoufou, Sahel Nutrition Industries'

features.description: The tender's history opens with a Replies only toggle applied, showing just the entries recorded from an email, Sahel's first.
features.verify: Playwright: after clicking [data-testid=history-replies-only], no 'Last chased' bookkeeping line is visible and Sahel's email event is first

features.description: Each email event shows the sender, the AI recorder and the excerpt behind one Source email toggle.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel's email event, opened, shows 'Amadou Issoufou, Sahel Nutrition Industries' and an excerpt containing 'EUR 0.31 per sachet'

scenes.narrative: In the tender's history, turned to replies only, Sahel's reply has arrived, recorded by the AI. She opens Sahel's own email: who wrote it, the domain it came from, the excerpt, and what the AI recorded from it, so the record answers to Sahel's words.
scenes.title: Sahel finally answers, and she opens the email

features.description: The comparison sets every quote side by side, one row per fact, puts main freight on us for an ex-works quote and our clearing estimate on every quote we import, and marks each fact a quote has not stated, without ranking quotes that cannot be compared; a quote missing a fact stays out of the count whatever the duty terms.
features.verify: Playwright: /compare/ [data-testid=comparable-count] reads '0 of 3 comparable'; Kanem Foods Ltd's pack cell reads 'not stated'; Sahel Nutrition Industries' column shows its price in EUR, its exchange rate missing and its freight 'ours: estimate not recorded'; tr[data-fact=clearing] reads 'USD 1.20 / carton (our estimate)' for Harmattan Therapeutics

features.description: A line at the top of the comparison states the tender's import duty terms; while they are not settled, every quote whose Incoterm leaves the import to us waits on them.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=comparison-duty-terms] reads 'Import duty: not settled'; Harmattan Therapeutics' [data-testid=grid-status] reads 'tender duty terms · to do' and its Next step offers 'Settle duty terms'

scenes.narrative: In the comparison, no quote can be compared yet. The tender's terms are not settled, and Harmattan quotes carriage paid to Kano, so its duty waits on them. Kanem has not stated its pack. Sahel quotes ex works Niamey. The freight from there, export clearance included, is ours to estimate. Our clearing estimate of USD 1.20 a carton applies. And Sahel's quote is in euros, with no exchange rate yet.
scenes.title: No quote can be compared yet: duty terms unsettled, facts missing

features.description: The tender's terms line settles its import duty terms in one choice, recorded as an attributed operation with a Revision.
features.verify: Playwright: after choosing buyer_waiver in [data-testid=duty-terms-select] and Save, [data-testid=tender-duty-terms] reads 'We import, under the program's duty waiver' and is marked just recorded

features.description: To do lists the reply owed to Northgate, with its count of questions and a Reply that opens the drafted email: each question restated, an answer to write under it.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=on-us] contains 'Reply to Northgate Commodities (3 questions)'; its [data-testid=move-cta] opens #drafts at the drafted reply

scenes.narrative: Back on the tender, Sophie settles import duty: we import, under the program's duty waiver, and the terms line reads it, just recorded. That settles who imports, the third of Northgate's questions, and Reply opens the reply drafted for them: each question restated with room for her answer, and the duty terms she just set written in, ready to send from her own mailbox.
scenes.title: She settles the tender's duty terms; the reply to Northgate is drafted

features.description: After the tender's duty terms are set, the comparison's duty line reads the waiver, the Import duty row is settled for every quote whose Incoterm leaves the import to us, and only the quotes missing no other fact become comparable.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=comparison-duty-terms] contains 'under the program's duty waiver'; no [data-testid=grid-action] reads 'Settle duty terms'; [data-testid=comparable-count] reads '1 of 3 comparable'; Harmattan Therapeutics' tr[data-fact=landed] cell reads 'USD 51.30'

features.description: Award is offered on a comparable quote before the deadline, its line showing what is still open on the tender: the days to the deadline, the silent suppliers and the replies we owe.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=award-open-facts] contains 'Deadline in 4 days', '2 silent' and '1 reply owed'

scenes.narrative: In the comparison the duty line reads the waiver, import duty is settled for the quotes we import, and Harmattan's quote is comparable, one of three: landed at USD 51.30, unconfirmed until the duty exemption is on file. Award is offered with what is still open: the deadline in four days, two suppliers silent and the reply owed to Northgate.
scenes.title: Harmattan becomes comparable, and Award says what is still open

features.description: The order's status chip says it is at customs, held, waiting on us, and To do lists the documents owed when a shipment requires them and they are not on file.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=order-status] reads 'At customs — held, waiting on us'; [data-testid=on-us] contains 'Provide 3 documents to Crescent Freight & Clearing'

features.description: The order timeline names Crescent Freight & Clearing as the sender of the status change, from source.sender.
features.verify: Playwright: order #history shows 'from Crescent Freight & Clearing'

features.description: The Billed vs agreed tile and To do flag an invoice above the contract, and its lines read billed against agreed.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=on-us] contains 'Review invoice'; [data-testid=invoice-variance-table] contains '51.20' and '49.80'

scenes.narrative: Tender 1's order with Harmattan for 2,000 cartons is at customs, held on us. Its invoice is billed above the agreed price, and the days late split between the supplier's 11 and our 20. The import permit and the customs declaration are ours: we owe them to the forwarder, whose email says the trucks wait at the border until the permit is lodged.
scenes.title: Tender 1's order: held on our permit, billed high

features.description: The overview counts the moves waiting on suppliers, each an invited supplier's reply not yet in.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=standing-their-moves] reads 'waiting on suppliers'

features.description: The order's row reads its stage and its next move, ours: the documents owed to the forwarder.
features.verify: Playwright: the order's [data-testid=next-move] contains 'Provide 3 documents to Crescent Freight & Clearing' and its [data-testid=whose] contains 'Us'

features.description: Each tender's row reads its stage on the six steps, its next move and whose it is: tender 2's move is ours and its chip counts the quotes the comparison can rank (1 of 3 comparable · Harmattan), and the just-asked RUSF tender's, with no replies yet, is the suppliers'.
features.verify: Playwright: tender 2's [data-testid=row-stage] contains 'Collecting quotes', its [data-testid=row-comparable] reads '1 of 3 comparable · Harmattan', and its [data-testid=whose] contains 'Us'; the RUSF tender's [data-testid=row-stage] contains 'Collecting quotes' and its [data-testid=whose] contains 'Suppliers'

scenes.narrative: Back on her overview, tender 2 leads with 1 of 3 comparable, Harmattan, and four of six have answered. Its open facts sit under its next move, which is hers: reply to Northgate's questions. Three to do are counted against five waiting on suppliers: the Maiduguri RUSF tender waits on its suppliers, and the tender 1 order at customs is hers.
scenes.title: Whose move each procurement is, ours or the suppliers'
